notes: Round-1 findings re-verified against my own harness render (--duration 120, frames 0,10,18,28,45,55,60,65,68,80,119). 1) Blocker (stage lost centering under FaRoot rtl): truly fixed. The stage wrapper has direction:ltr, and the hero card in fa f0, f60 and f119 sits at x~700..1190, pixel-identical in position to orig f0. The fan stays inside the frame, with the farthest clone ending at about x=1280. 2) Card internals mirrored undocumented: fixed. Every Card is wrapped in direction:ltr, so the avatar and bars match the original at bottom-left and top-left, and the choice is documented in the header and report. 3) Fan direction undecided: decided and documented, with the original direction kept. The justification is thin but defensible, and the f45 and f60 compositions look balanced. I also checked the timing constants against the original. N, GAP_Z, SPREAD_START, HOLD_END, MERGE_DUR, springs, easing, seed, perspective and fps are all unchanged, the export name is intact, and the 3D transforms are unchanged. The title «پژواک عمق کلون‌ها» is correctly shaped, centered, has no Latin leftovers, uses Persian ی/ک and has an adequate 1.4 line-height. There are no raster assets. The harness had no errors. Later original frames do not exist in the truncated MP4 (only f0 is available), so f0 comparison plus unchanged code is the fidelity evidence. This is shippable.
